summary: RC2.5 frontend confidence-badge fix verified. Auto-Investigate on obfuscated PowerShell -EncodedCommand payload correctly renders 'CONF · N/A · DECODED' in DecodingTracePanel and InvestigationGraph headers instead of a misleading '0% CONFIDENCE'. No bare '0% CONFIDENCE' text appears anywhere in the DOM. The workspace VerdictCard on the right still shows its backend-computed value ('SUSPICIOUS · 58/100'), unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: SocVerdictPanel.jsx path was NOT observed in live testing because the sample payload (base64-encoded downloader) does not trip the shellcode/loader-script detectors (needs FromBase64String + -bxor + VirtualAlloc). Fix is verified only by static code review (lines 61-62 use identical `hasConf = Number.isFinite(confidence) && confidence > 0` guard and fall back to 'n/a · decoded'). Main agent may want to sanity-check with a real Meterpreter loader sample once available.
DecodingTracePanel.jsx line 18 has `if (!trace || trace.length === 0) return null;  const OP_ICONS = {...` on the same line — minor style nit, works fine but hurts readability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/3 panels verified live, 1 verified by code review)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The RC2.5 confidence-badge fix works. DOM check: /(0%\s*CONFIDENCE)/ has zero matches and /CONF · N/A · DECODED/ has 2 matches (dtp + inv-graph) after Auto-Investigate on the sample base64 PowerShell payload. To exercise SocVerdictPanel branch you need a Meterpreter-style loader (FromBase64String + -bxor + VirtualAlloc/func_get_proc_address). The inline one triggered the smart decode + polling analyze flow correctly.
rca of the issue: RC2.4 previously fixed the same '0% CONFIDENCE' misleading badge for chain-mode stage headers and flat-decode status pill in WorkspacePage.jsx (lines 438-446, 566-571). RC2.5 extended the same `hasConf = Number.isFinite(confidence) && confidence > 0` guard to three more surfaces (DecodingTracePanel header, InvestigationGraph header, SocVerdictPanel ticket string + VerdictField) so that when the deterministic engine decoded a chain but returned confidence=0/null, the UI shows 'CONF · N/A · DECODED' / 'n/a · decoded' instead. Live-verified in the DOM for the first two; SocVerdictPanel verified by code review.
